MCL-3014 and MCL-3014-R




**The MCL-3014 will not fit the 2019 and newer Harley Davidson Street Glide, Road Glide, Ultra Limited, Tri Glide and all CVO models. 

The all new Dakota Digital instrumentation for the 2014 - 2018 *Harley-Davidson Street Glide, Road Glide, Ultra Limited,Tri Glide and all CVO models is here! Dakota Digital continues to be the leader and forerunner in innovation of aftermarket Direct Fit, Plug and Play instrumentation for Harley Davidson bikes. The MCL-3014 display adds vibrant blue or red digital readouts with improved functionality and visibility over the OEM! 
MCL-3014 utilizes the stock chrome trim rings from the OEM gauges.

  • Speedometer
  • Tachometer with bar graph Tachometer that wraps around the crown of the Tachometer.
  • Oil Temperature (sender included)
  • Volts
  • Fuel Level wraps around the crown of the Speedometer
  • Gear Position
  • Clock
  • Odometer
  • A & B Trip meters
  • Service Meter (miles until next service)
  • Performance Meters
    • 1/4 mile Speed and Time
    • 0-60 time
    • High Speed and RPM recall
  • Indicators:
    • Turn Signals, High Beam, Cruise Control, Check Engine, Security, ABS and Reverse and Parking Brake (available on Tri-Glide).

Additional readouts can be added to the MCL-3014 in the odometer/ trip or clock displays or by replacing the Oil Temp gauge with alternate Air Pressure or Boost gauge. The use of the Dakota Digital MBM expansion modules are required regardless of whether or not a gauge is ordered.

Air Suspension Pressure***

MCL-3K14-A: Air Pressure gauge. (requires MBM-19)
        - Available in Blue or Red lighting
MBM-19 - Includes 1 sender.

 For 2 pressure systems such as a front and rear, one pressure reading will display in either the odometer or clock window of the speedometer or tachometer. This installation requires an additional sender SEN-1901 to be installed with the MBM-19.

Boost Pressure***

MCL-3K14-B: Boost Pressure gauge. (requires MBM-09)
        - Available in Blue or Red lighting
MBM-09 - Sender included.

** When installing MCL-3K14-B or MCL-3K14-A gauges, the Oil Temp reading will no longer be available.
*** The addition of Air Pressure or Boost Pressure require a base MCL-3014 package with a software code of MC14 or higher.  Earlier software codes can be updated by Dakota Digital if returned for service.

Please call 1-800-593-4160 or Contact a Dealer to purchase this kit.
